scope: Manual runtime/depth policy overlay for future GMUT-focused heartbeat phases. This supplements published v6/v7 without overwriting prior canon.

observed_pattern: Earlier v462A_GMUT_v1-v5 screenshots showed roughly 18-24 minute phase durations.
Later v462A_GMUT_v6 and v7 screenshots showed shorter durations, approximately 15 minutes and 8 minutes.
The user asked to restore the prior 20-25 minute evidence workflow while keeping automation flowing.
operator_screenshot_runtime_context.claim_limit: Screenshot-visible runtimes are pacing evidence, not proof of artifact quality by themselves.

app_lane_advisory_synthesis.Cicero: Use v6R as an additive repair overlay; preserve v6/v7 canon; classify claims and repair overclaim wording rather than rewriting prior artifacts.
app_lane_advisory_synthesis.Kierkegaard: Depth is fidelity to scope and evidence, not time consumed; close on evidence, not elapsed time.
app_lane_advisory_synthesis.Aristotle: Distinguish made reviewable from made true; Solas v44-v48 material is source-context, not canon or validation.
app_lane_advisory_synthesis.Parfit_Lorentz: Use a 40-minute interval with 20-25 minutes active work and 15-20 minutes buffer for lane checks, synthesis, and publication hygiene.

recommended_interval.reason: The intended average active phase depth is 20-25 minutes. A 40-minute interval adds a 10-15 minute safety buffer for slow lane returns, git checks, validation, and curated publication.

close_early_conditions: live head and drift are verified
prior phase status and relevant baseline artifacts are read
four App lane attempts are made when safely reachable, or blockers are recorded
Arby and Aster Vale parent-shell CLI checkpoints are made, with child report attempts only when safe
claims are classified as evidence, context, hypothesis, blocker, or advisory
all curated artifacts validate and publication preflight passes
no meaningful scoped question remains unresolved except explicit blockers
runtime_floor_policy.do_not_fill_time_rule: Do not manufacture work merely to satisfy elapsed time. If scoped evidence is complete, close cleanly. If work is incomplete, carry blockers honestly.

shallow_run_compensator.trigger: If a phase closes under 15 minutes while formal GMUT scaffold, fixture, source-authority, or gate language remains in scope.
required_response: record that the phase was short
perform or schedule a remaster/depth overlay before promoting the next phase's conclusions
avoid treating speed as proof of adequacy
record any skipped lane or source-review blockers

future_phase_shape.work: live head check, upstream drift, expected phase-version, dirty-scope awareness
App lane advisory attempts and prior artifact read
Arby/Aster Vale CLI parent checkpoints and bounded child report attempt only if safe
GMUT gate ledger, source-context or fixture work, contradiction hunt, claim classification
curated synthesis, JSON parse, path/credential/whitespace checks, staged diff review, commit, push, remote verification
